item.title: MiniDebConf Winterthur
item.description:
My experience at MiniDebCamp and MiniDebConf @ Winterthur

Link to the ConfPage.

Thanks to Debian for paying for my stay. This was an extremely important experience: I understood where I want (and can) contribute to the project the most.

Tuesday

I arrived just in time for the packaging workshop, given by Andreas Tille, former DPL.

The workshop dealt with fixing some bugs in existing debian packages, e.g. the version control system or the homepage link. It had the idea, in Adreas’ words, of showing the (or better, one of the possible) workflows of Debian packaging.

item.title: Fragile
item.description:
So many good things have happened this year of my life that I’ve started wondering.

I wonder how the things that happen turn out to shape a life. In my case, COVID had an extremely big impact on my life, so much that I sometimes wonder what beautiful things could have happened if not for it. You probably have your own things that make you wonder!

Yesterday I was laying in bed thinking about this, and a simple came into my mind: Fragile. I said, life is fragile! But I did not mean it in the physical sense.
